_meta.description: Two-sample z-test on revenue split by treatment arm via TEST_Z_TWO_SAMPLE — the large-sample asymptotic sibling of TEST_T / TEST_WELCH. Reuses the standardNormalCDF helper backing the OVERLAY_Z_CELL / OVERLAY_Z_VS_REF parity overlays so the row-test surface and the overlay surface emit identical p-values for the same (mean, variance, n) inputs. Paired with TEST_WELCH so the example surfaces the parametric distinction (Student's t vs standard normal) on the same fixture.
_meta.name: z_two_sample_revenue
